description: Which docs/skills/ operating playbooks apply to each chart, derived from the master matrix by documented rules. Advisory, not a proof. Generated by scripts/generate-chart-skills.mjs; do not hand-edit.

skills_catalog.title: Serious Chart Playbooks
skills_catalog.rule: named hard chart (kube-prometheus-stack, consul, cert-manager, external-secrets, loki) OR quirk_features has both crds and webhooks

skills_catalog.title: Hook And Secret Lifecycle
skills_catalog.rule: hook_count > 0 OR quirk_features has hooks, generated-facts, or webhooks

skills_catalog.title: Target Facts And Lifecycle
skills_catalog.rule: quirk_features has crds, webhooks, lookup, generated-facts, stateful-storage, or required

skills_catalog.title: Large App Evidence Funnel
skills_catalog.rule: quirk_features has crds OR the chart is serious (proxy for many-Unit charts, pending a per-chart object count)

skills_catalog.title: Live Parity
skills_catalog.rule: outcome_level shows local-live / live-parity / two-cluster, OR catalog_tier is catalog-supported
